query:
ALTER TABLE orders 
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customerName VARCHAR(255),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customerEmail VARCHAR(320),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS customerPhone VARCHAR(32),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shippingAddress TEXT,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shippingCity VARCHAR(128),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shippingCountry VARCHAR(64),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shippingPostalCode VARCHAR(32),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS shippingCost INT DEFAULT 0,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS currency VARCHAR(8) DEFAULT 'XOF',
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paymentMethod VARCHAR(64),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paymentStatus ENUM('PENDING', 'PAID', 'FAILED', 'REFUNDED') DEFAULT 'PENDING',
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paymentTransactionId VARCHAR(255),
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS paidAt TIMESTAMP NULL,
ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS notes TEXT
